title: Prospective gradientless noncommuting operator/latent-grammar identification

base.wsp54_classification: anchored positive SELFTEST; noncommuting deliberately unimplemented; full regression pending

hypothesis: A bounded, evidence-consistent factorization of raw acoustic streams into persistent entity identities, latent unary modular-affine operations and their noncommuting composition order may permit transfer to unseen entity/operation/state combinations without gradient steps. When the observed consequences do not identify the current operator order, the learner must abstain instead of consuming a test-harness phase label.

worlds.source: Read-only WSP53 source.py evaluation fixture, never imported by the learner; use SELFTEST seeds 9901/9902 and encodings identity/permuted/rotated only
worlds.family: noncommuting_order; anchored_effect retained only for regression
worlds.holdout_use: score only; not used in model construction, adaptive threshold selection or context
worlds.forbid: DEV/PRIMARY cohorts and hidden SourceWorld fields, codebook, grammar, semantic triple, true operator functions, oracle outputs

hard_conditions: Learner receives only public Observation(before, acoustic_bits, after, action_cost, reset_cost)
No true source operation tables or hidden word boundaries; affine/mod-7 function hypothesis class is an explicitly charged prior, not inferred universal physics
Prediction interface has no phase label, phase switch, true order, or externally selected regime
Any context for regime inference is a bounded chronological ledger of already charged action-consequence observations; never heldout rows
Respect prefix-free raw strings with 4-6 bit latent segments only as a declared search prior; wrong parse/circuit consensus abstains
No post-result tuning and no choice of favorable SELFTEST subset; all six noncommuting fixtures and their failures count
Cold restore and evidence tamper/noncanonical rejection mandatory
Keep WSP54 code/results immutable; do not alter original WSP53 fixture, seeds, or sealed first-use

search_prior.operators: Four latent unary affine maps x->(a*x+b) mod7, a,b in [0,6], including constants, independently inferred from data; operator identity/order must not be read from source.py
search_prior.codes: three concatenated 4-6-bit prefix-free codewords; 8 physical entities and 4 operations; find roles and lexicon from evidence

metrics: B heldout without use_phase or comparable oracle selector
post-switch A cold-restore retention without manually selecting phase
action/CPU/wall/search-nodes/memory including raw evidence and code
source SHA/cold provenance plus negative controls
selftest_development_criterion: All 6 noncommuting SELFTEST worlds assessed. Positive engineering signal requires >=48/792 aggregate exact heldout noncommuting predictions with zero wrong-confident predictions, >=1 genuinely swap-order-sensitive correct contrast, no external phase selector and exact cold-restore parity. Below criterion is a preserved negative prototype. This threshold is not a scientifically protected claim.
baselines: WSP53 count-only and 64-step hybrid SELFTEST historical diagnostics, labelled unmatched controls
independent order-blind / order-swapped / state-erased negative controls
eventual fully trained neural and exhaustive independently implemented symbolic comparators required before science
scientific_admission: No protected science/DEV/PRIMARY first use, no SCIENTIFIC_PASS, no merge, promotion, deployment or official loop integration. Prospective separate validation needs fully trained conventional baseline, independent symbolic comparator, matched information/actions and whole-process compute, seeds, inference and memory, and separate admission.
stop_rules: Budget exhaustion or incompatible hypotheses => abstain
Never count ambiguous/no-change contrasts as correct
No adaptively inspecting heldout failures to adjust code and relabel results as science
Do not use paid APIs, scheduled tasks, new controller, or unauthorized first-use
